en.name: Muffin mix, dry
en.summary: Dry packaged muffin mix keeps 9 months in the pantry, sealed, in a cool dry cupboard. It is a shelf-stable dry good, so what runs out is not safety but performance: the raising agent loses power and any fat in the mix slowly goes rancid.
en.pantry: 9 months sealed in a cool, dry, dark cupboard, and go by the printed date as well. Two things age in a muffin mix. The chemical raising agent — baking powder, sometimes soda — gradually loses the gas it can produce, so an old mix bakes flat and dense. And most mixes contain a powdered fat or oil, which is what eventually turns rancid and gives an old box a faint crayon or cardboard smell. Keep the box away from the hob and the kettle, because heat and steam are what age both. Once opened, tip the contents into an airtight jar; an open paper liner takes on moisture and is an invitation to pantry moths.
en.fridge: There is no refrigerated timeline for dry muffin mix and it does not need one. A cold box collects condensation every time it comes out, and damp is precisely what makes a dry mix clump, lose its raising power and eventually mould. Keep it in the cupboard. The exception is a hot, humid kitchen with nowhere cool at all, in which case seal the mix into an airtight jar first so that no moisture can reach the powder.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for dry muffin mix. Freezing a sealed, airtight jar does slow the fat going rancid and is a reasonable thing to do with a mix you have bought in bulk, but repeated trips in and out cause condensation and caking, which is the one thing the powder cannot tolerate. If you do freeze it, freeze it in one sealed portion and let it return to room temperature before opening the jar.
spoilage: Muffins that bake flat and dense, the sign the raising agent has gone.
A stale, cardboard or crayon smell from the powder — rancid fat.
Hard clumps that will not break up, meaning moisture got in.
Webbing, larvae or small moths in the box, which means the whole box goes out.
tips: Decant an opened box into an airtight jar and keep the instructions.
Test a doubtful mix by dropping a spoonful into hot water; a dead raising agent barely fizzes.
Store it away from the hob, the kettle and the sink.
Buy the box size you will actually use within the date.

faq.q: How long does dry muffin mix last?
faq.a: 9 months sealed in a cool dry cupboard, and to the printed date. After that it is not unsafe, but it bakes flat and can taste stale.

faq.q: Can you use muffin mix past its date?
faq.a: Usually yes, for quality rather than safety reasons — expect a flatter, denser muffin. Throw it out if it smells rancid or has taken on damp.

faq.q: Does muffin mix need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. The fridge adds condensation each time the box comes out, and damp is what ruins a dry mix. A cool dry cupboard is better.

zh.name: 瑪芬預拌粉
zh.summary: 市售乾式瑪芬預拌粉密封放在陰涼乾燥的櫃子裡，可放 9 個月。它是常溫乾貨，所以先用完的不是安全，而是效能：膨脹劑會失去力氣，粉裡的油脂也會慢慢油耗。
zh.pantry: 密封放在陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫃子裡 9 個月，同時也看包裝上的印製日期。預拌粉裡有兩樣東西在老化。化學膨脹劑（泡打粉，有時還有小蘇打）能放出的氣體會逐漸變少，所以放久的粉烤出來又扁又密。另外多數預拌粉含有粉狀油脂，那才是最後會油耗的部分，讓一盒老粉聞起來有淡淡的蠟筆味或紙板味。盒子要遠離爐火和熱水壺，因為熱和蒸氣正是讓這兩件事加速的原因。拆封後請把粉倒進密封罐；開了口的紙袋會吸濕，也等於在邀請穀蛾。
zh.fridge: 乾式預拌粉沒有冷藏期限，也不需要。冰過的盒子每次拿出來都會結露，而受潮正是讓乾粉結塊、失去膨脹力、最後長霉的原因，放櫃子就好。唯一的例外是又熱又濕、家裡根本沒有陰涼處的廚房；那就先把粉裝進完全密封的罐子再冰，讓水氣碰不到粉。
zh.freezer: 乾式預拌粉沒有公布的冷凍期限。把密封罐整罐冷凍確實能拖慢油脂油耗，對大量採購的人是合理的做法；但反覆進出會結露、結塊，而那正是粉最受不了的一件事。真要冷凍就一次密封一份，開罐前先讓它回到室溫。
spoilage: 烤出來又扁又密，表示膨脹劑已經沒力了。
粉聞起來走味、有紙板味或蠟筆味——那是油耗。
結成壓不散的硬塊，表示水氣跑進去了。
盒子裡出現絲網、幼蟲或小蛾，整盒丟掉。
tips: 拆封後倒進密封罐，並把包裝上的做法剪下來留著。
不確定還有沒有力，就舀一小匙丟進熱水；死掉的膨脹劑幾乎不冒泡。
遠離爐火、熱水壺和水槽。
買在有效日期內用得完的份量。

faq.q: 瑪芬預拌粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放陰涼乾燥處 9 個月，並以印製日期為準。過了之後不是不安全，而是會烤得扁、吃起來走味。

faq.q: 過期的瑪芬預拌粉還能用嗎？
faq.a: 通常可以，那是品質問題不是安全問題——預期會烤得比較扁比較密。但如果聞起來油耗或已經受潮，就丟掉。

faq.q: 瑪芬預拌粉需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不用。盒子每次從冰箱拿出來都會結露，而受潮正是毀掉乾粉的原因。陰涼乾燥的櫃子更好。
